Que choisir
— a consumer magazine in France — followed the evolution of a GoPro Hero 4 black edition between January 15, 2015, and February 15, 2015.

On each of the four online sellers observed, the prices varied from one day to the next by 100 euros, and at one point, the spread between the prices offered by the different sellers reached 150 euros. This volatility of prices, comparable to that of financial markets, and their multiplicity are not mysterious if one accepts that prices are one among many qualities that play a crucial part in the singularization process. The price can even depend on whether or not the customer is looking into the different prices on offer through a search engine — that is, on the specific behavior and expectations of a particular consumer. On the supplier’s side, it is less a matter of knowing whether the prices offered by the competition are different than it is of knowing whether the web user cares! Can one imagine a higher-precision bespoke service than a service that takes into account the customer’s preoccupations and leastpublic behavior?

受收益管理工作启发，大多数在线企业都招募了整支团队从事价格构式。这些专家既处理内部数据（库存物品数量、产品的存续时间），也处理外部数据，每天数次收集数十个网站上数百种货号的价格。因此，他们能够追踪供给的变化以及所售物品品质界定的变化，而这种重新界定品质包括调整价格。以算法形式出现的公式，在每个时刻确定将使利润最大化的价格。在这些公式中，天气、一天中的时刻、上网者是否访问过比价网站、学校假期临近、当晚电视播放什么、大报文学副刊的内容等要素，都是可能被纳入考虑的变量。更个人化的数据，例如电脑的品牌（Mac 用户被推定更有钱），也可以在构式中被纳入考虑。定价技术人员——尤其是在电子商务中——日益重要的作用，转化为不断变动的价格。价格如今是动态的。法国消费者杂志《选择》（
Que choisir
）追踪了一款 GoPro Hero 4 黑色版在2015年1月15日至2015年2月15日之间的价格演变。

在被观察的四家网络卖家中，每一家的价格都逐日变动达100欧元，而在某一时点，不同卖家所提供价格之间的差距达到150欧元。这种堪与金融市场相比的价格波动性，以及价格的多重性，并不神秘——只要人们接受：价格是在独一化过程中起关键作用的众多品质之一。价格甚至可以取决于顾客是否通过搜索引擎查看各种在售价格——也就是说，取决于某个特定消费者的具体行为与预期。在供应商一方，问题与其说是要了解竞争者提供的价格是否不同，不如说是要了解网络用户是否在意！人们能想象一种比这更精确的量身定制服务吗——它把顾客的关切以及其最不公开的行为都纳入考虑？

I could give many more examples. Yield management and the science of price formulation are everywhere. What should be emphasized, however, is that pricing plane or train tickets is one of the simplest cases. Without leaving the transportation sector, to understand how complex certain formulations have become, consider a longer time frame. Personalizing seats is then no longer reducible to the logistics of reservations. In the long term, it will depend on the configurations of aircraft. Architecture and design have contributed to this movement through their own evolution over a number of years. They now make interior layouts more flexible and more easily diversified, consistently aiming at enabling price discrimination. Each of the sites that participates in the design and implementation of these innovations thus becomes party to the formulation of prices, whose complexity grows.

我还能举出更多例子。收益管理与价格构式科学无处不在。然而应当强调，为飞机票或火车票定价属于最简单的情形之一。不必离开运输部门，只要考虑一个更长的时间尺度，就能理解某些构式已变得多么复杂。此时，座位的个性化不再能化约为预订的组织管理。从长期看，它将取决于飞机的构型。建筑与设计通过自身多年来的演变，推动了这一运动。它们如今使舱内布局更加灵活、更容易多样化，并始终以促成价格歧视为目标。于是，参与这些创新的设计与实施的每一个场所，都成为价格构式的一方，而价格构式的复杂性也随之增长。

One can go even further in exploring the role played by pricing over the course of goods’ transformation and singularization. Just as machining, wire drawing, and stamping techniques can be applied to different materials in different industrial sectors, as the spread of yield management shows, price formulation techniques can be equally applied to the sale of plane or train seats, hotel reservations, or the sale of electronic products. If they are full-fledged contributors to the production process of goods, it is because they intervene materially in this process.

They are devices that act on goods by transforming them. (This is why a seat on the TGV is qualculated differently by yield management than a seat on a local train qualculated by the tricolor system.) This observation is obvious for industrial procedures, whose technical conception takes the calculation of costs into account, notably through the methods of value analysis, but it is no less true when one considers final consumption. In the latter case, the price has a tangible material existence (bar codes, labels, various inscriptions) that visibly affects the good, much like tattoos or scarifications transform a body and change its expression.

If one turns one’s attention to the materiality of prices and its role in the qualification of goods, Catherine Grandclément’s descriptions of supermarkets come to appear as the revelation of something that, like Edgar Allan Poe’s purloined letter, had become invisible by being too visible.

Try the experiment yourself: go into a Walmart Supercenter one day when, as the expression goes, prices are slashed, and you will be as disoriented as a French visitor in the streets of Hong Kong. There is a proliferation of tags, labels, streamers, multicolored banners, discount coupons, crossed-out prices, and formulas calculating the savings to be grabbed. The customer wanders among price qualculations as much as among the goods on offer, in a strange palace of mirrors in which the prices on display infinitely diffract and multiply, connecting to one another, coloring the goods with new nuances, and finally becoming one with them; the label invites the customer to enter into this maze and to find his own way to the goods that await him, the ones that have been specially designed for him.
在考察定价在物品转化与独一化过程中所起作用时，人们还可以走得更远。正如机加工、拉丝与冲压技术可以应用于不同工业部门中的不同材料，价格构式技术同样可以应用于飞机或火车座位销售、酒店预订或电子产品销售，收益管理的传播即表明了后一点。如果说它们是物品生产过程的正式参与者，那是因为它们以物质的方式介入这一过程。
它们是作用于物品、通过转化物品而行动的装置。（正因如此，收益管理对 TGV 座位的质算，不同于三色系统对普通列车座位的质算。）这一观察对于工业流程显而易见——工业流程的技术构想会把成本计算纳入考虑，尤其是通过价值分析方法——但当我们考察最终消费时，它同样成立。在后一种情形中，价格具有可触的物质存在（条形码、标签、各种标记），它可见地影响物品，很像纹身或瘢痕刻痕改变一个身体并改变其表情。
如果把注意力转向价格的物质性及其在物品品质界定中的作用，那么卡特琳·格朗克莱芒（Catherine Grandclément）对超市的描述，就显得是在揭示某种像爱伦·坡（Edgar Allan Poe）的《失窃的信》一样因过于显眼而变得不可见的东西。

不妨自己做个实验：在所谓“大降价”的那一天走进一家沃尔玛超级中心（Walmart Supercenter），你会像一位置身香港街头的法国游客那样晕头转向。标签、标牌、飘带、彩色横幅、折扣券、划掉的价格、计算能省下多少钱的公式，纷纷涌现，层出不穷。顾客在价格质算之间游荡，正如在待售物品之间游荡；这是一座奇异的镜宫，展示的价格在其中无限衍射、增殖，彼此连接，以新的细微差别为物品着色，最终与物品融为一体；标签邀请顾客进入这座迷宫，找到自己的路，走向那些等待着他的物品——那些专为他设计的物品。

Taking the price as a singular quality into account is not new, even if, until recently, it was both hard to manipulate and hard for those who watch markets from the outside to understand and to acknowledge. Pricing professionals have long known how to do this, as the technique of line pricing used by fiveand-dime stores shows. In that instance, the customer simply decides to buy the price before they decide which item to buy at that price.
把价格当作一种独一品质来考虑并不新鲜，尽管直到不久以前，它既难以操作，也难以为那些从外部观察市场的人所理解和承认。定价专业人士早就知道如何这样做，五分一角店（five-and-dime stores）所使用的价格线定价（line pricing）技术即是一例。在那种情形中，顾客先决定要买什么价格，然后才决定以该价格买哪件商品。
PRICE FORMULATION AND TRANSACTION VOLUME

An airline company that practices yield management personalizes each of the seats it offers to its clientele and therefore faces off against a set of demands that are singular, that together add up in the company’s accounts. How is the best possible combination of prices to be selected? There is no one best way. A company can calculate fares that optimize a variable it considers relevant (for instance, the ratio of margin to sales volume), the constraints on investment it imposes on itself (fleet composition — number and models of planes, interior layout, total payroll, and so on), or the constraints that are imposed on it (the architecture of air routes, the location of the hub, and more), as well as the offers expected from the competition. Whatever the objectives, a priori, the calculation can be only indicative; the single realistic procedure is progressive trial and error.
价格构式与交易量

实行收益管理的航空公司把提供给顾客的每个座位都个性化，因此面对着一组独一的需求，而这些需求加总起来体现在公司的账目中。如何选择尽可能最佳的价格组合？并不存在唯一的最佳方式。公司可以计算票价，使之优化它认为相关的某一变量（例如利润与销售量之比）；计算时要考虑它给自己施加的投资约束（机队构成——飞机数量与型号、舱内布局、工资总额等），或外界强加给它的约束（航线架构、枢纽位置等），以及它预期竞争者会给出的报价。无论目标如何，先验地看，计算只能是指示性的；唯一现实的程序是逐步试错。

The ever-greater singularization of services can lead to an extraordinary complexity of calculations that require numerous iterations before leading to a result that can be considered satisfactory. The complexity is even greater well upstream from the process of the qualification of goods, at the beginning of singularizing the product and with it the qualculation of intermediary price, as in the case for pharmaceutical products. As a consequence, the calculation of the aggregate value of the variables considered as strategic by a pharmaceutical company (traditionally, they consider sales volume, return on investment, ecological footprint, and more) is not obtained directly from the quantities sold, since each good has different characteristics. The calculation must endeavor to assess as systematically and precisely as possible how much each good sold contributes to the achievement of the company’s overall objectives. Quantities and qualities become inseparable: in a situation of extreme price discrimination, a singular configuration of qualities can correspond only to a single good and a single customer.

服务日益加深的独一化，可能导致计算变得极其复杂，需要多次迭代才能得出一个可被视为令人满意的结果。在物品品质界定过程的上游很远之处——在开始独一化产品、并随之质算中间价格之时——复杂性还要更大，药品的情形便是如此。因此，制药公司对其视为战略性的各变量（传统上，它们考虑销售量、投资回报率、生态足迹等）之总值的计算，并不是直接从售出数量中得出的，因为每件物品都有不同的特征。计算必须尽力尽可能系统而精确地评估每件售出物品对公司总体目标之实现作出了多大贡献。数量与品质变得不可分割：在极端价格歧视的情境中，一种独一的品质构型只能对应一件物品和一位顾客。

In sum, the discriminating monopoly model is precious because it makes it possible to understand how the modalities of affixing prices (price formulation) participate concretely in the process of qualifying and singularizing goods while keeping open the possibility of multiplying and summing bilateral transactions. Whether the supplier concentrates on a particular service or chooses to serve a great number of clients, price formulation follows the same logic. From one configuration to the other, the only change is in the number of transactions that complicate the qualculation. To do full justice to the dynamic of market agencements, the model must be expanded: it is not sufficient to say that the same product is offered at different prices to different clients. Rather, what is on offer are products that are each different from one another, whose singularization may have begun well upstream, and that have stayed connected to each other throughout the production process, often through technological interdependencies. Singularization and massification are not opposed to one another. They are mutually reinforcing.

总之，歧视性垄断模型之所以宝贵，是因为它使人能够理解：确定价格的方式（价格构式）如何具体参与物品的品质界定与独一化过程，同时又保持使双边交易成倍增加并加总起来的可能性。无论供应商专注于某一特定服务，还是选择服务大量顾客，价格构式都遵循同一逻辑。从一种构型到另一种构型，唯一的变化在于使质算复杂化的交易数量。要充分把握市场装配的动态，模型必须加以扩展：仅仅说同一产品以不同价格提供给不同顾客是不够的。更确切地说，待售的是彼此各不相同的产品，它们的独一化可能早在很上游便已开始，并在整个生产过程中始终彼此保持联系，往往是通过技术上的相互依赖。独一化与规模化并不彼此对立。它们相互强化。

In the model of interface markets, where platform goods compete with each other, the aggregation of transactions does not raise any particular difficulties. Since prices apply to the same products, the calculation of the relation between price and quantity is (relatively) simple.

In the model of market agencements, one cannot talk about the supply curve, the demand curve, or their intersection since the characteristics of the good vary with the volume offered by the supplier. The situation that serves as a reference to understanding these agencements is the confrontation between discriminating monopolies, each of them offering each of its customers a particular good and a particular price.
在界面市场模型中，平台物品彼此竞争，交易的加总不会带来什么特别的困难。由于价格适用于同样的产品，价格与数量之间关系的计算（相对）简单。
在市场装配模型中，人们不能谈论供给曲线、需求曲线或它们的交点，因为物品的特征随供应商所提供的数量而变化。可作为理解这些装配之参照的情境，是歧视性垄断之间的对峙，其中每一个垄断者都向自己的每一位顾客提供一种特定物品和一个特定价格。

This configuration is not unique to the most advanced market organizations. It is very common and does not threaten the viability and continuity of market agencements. Economist Alan Kirman demonstrated this brilliantly in his famous study of the Marseille fish market.
这种构型并非最先进的市场组织所独有。它十分常见，并不威胁市场装配的存续与连续性。经济学家艾伦·柯尔曼（Alan Kirman）在其关于马赛鱼市的著名研究中出色地证明了这一点。

Fish markets are classic objects for economics, first, because they are very old, but also because of the wide diversity of their forms of organization (auctions by ascending or descending price or over the counter). Kirman chose to study Marseille’s markets because there were detailed data on the transactions. He was able to analyze information pertaining to each individual transaction — 237,162 in total — over a three-year period that recorded the identities of buyer and seller, the category of fish, the weight of the lot, the sale price, and the temporal position of the transaction in the daily series of transactions of each seller. There were also other characteristics that make Marseille a particularly interesting object of study. It is a large market, and its organization is original: more than five hundred buyers and forty-five sellers meet in the wholesale market in Saumaty, even if not all are present every day.

More than one hundred and thirty types of fish are sold. Moreover, prices are not posted ahead of time, and no one knows how much stock is for sale when the market opens. Finally, all sales take place over the counter — that is to say, bilaterally. There is little negotiation, little bargaining, and the prices given by each seller are to be considered as “Take it or leave it.” Kirman’s analysis yields surprising results. A high proportion of buyers are faithful to their sellers. Furthermore, in a single day, the same vendor may offer different prices to different customers, and the consecutive prices for a single type of fish for different buyers can vary by up to 30 percent. Moreover, faithful customers are systematically charged the highest prices. It is enough to make Air France or EDF pale with envy!

鱼市是经济学的经典研究对象，首先因为它们非常古老，但也因为其组织形式极为多样（升价拍卖、降价拍卖或柜台交易）。柯尔曼选择研究马赛的市场，是因为那里有详细的交易数据。他得以分析三年期内每一笔单独交易的信息——总共237,162笔——这些记录包括买方与卖方的身份、鱼的类别、每批鱼的重量、成交价格，以及该笔交易在每位卖方每日交易序列中的时间位置。还有一些其他特征使马赛成为特别有趣的研究对象。这是一个大市场，其组织方式也别具一格：五百多名买方与四十五名卖方在索马蒂（Saumaty）的批发市场相聚，尽管并非所有人每天都到场。

出售的鱼有一百三十多种。此外，价格并不事先公布，市场开盘时谁也不知道有多少存货待售。最后，所有销售都在柜台上进行——也就是说，以双边方式进行。谈判很少，讨价还价很少，每个卖方给出的价格都应被视为“要么接受，要么拉倒”。柯尔曼的分析得出了令人惊讶的结果。很高比例的买方忠于自己的卖方。此外，在同一天里，同一个卖主可能向不同顾客提供不同价格，而同一种鱼面向不同买方的连续价格可能相差高达30%。更有甚者，忠实顾客系统性地被收取最高价格。这足以让法国航空或法国电力羡慕得脸色发白！
Overall, Kirman shows that the Marseille market is a realistic model of competition between discriminating monopolies.

The lesson is all the more relevant because buyers and sellers are invited to conclude their transaction within a rigid spatiotemporal framework within earshot of one another. One might have imagined that the usual modalities of competition would prevail in such conditions. Not so. Instead of the perfect competition of neoclassical markets that one might have expected, one discovers the perfect competition of market agencements. The data Kirman analyzed prove beyond any possible doubt what one suspected — namely, that while short of being natural and spontaneous, an organization that rests on competition between discriminating monopolies is commonplace and perfectly viable.
总体而言，柯尔曼表明，马赛市场是歧视性垄断之间竞争的一个现实模型。
这一教益之所以更加切题，是因为买方与卖方被要求在一个刚性的时空框架内、在彼此听得见的范围内完成交易。人们或许会以为，在这种条件下，惯常的竞争方式会占据主导。事实并非如此。人们没有发现所期待的新古典市场的完全竞争，反而发现了市场装配的完全竞争。柯尔曼所分析的数据无可置疑地证明了人们此前猜想的事情：一种建立在歧视性垄断之间竞争之上的组织，虽然并非自然而然、自发产生，却十分常见，而且完全可行。

Air France, Amazon, and EDF are not the only ones to play the discriminating monopoly card. It is a general practice. That is why I am arguing that this can and should serve as the reference model for understanding how agencies elaborate price qualculations that reconcile the singularity of goods with the multiplication of bilateral transactions in a satisfying way.
法国航空、亚马逊与法国电力并不是仅有的打出歧视性垄断这张牌的企业。这是一种普遍做法。正因如此，我主张，这个模型可以而且应当充当参照模型，用以理解能动者如何制定价格质算，从而以令人满意的方式调和物品的独一性与双边交易的成倍增加。
WHY PRICE COMPETITION AND NONPRICE COMPETITION IS A FALSE DISTINCTION
为何价格竞争与非价格竞争是一个虚假的区分

Consider the case of mobile telephone service providers when a new operator, Free, entered the French market in 1999 with an aggressive commercial strategy. Let us look at this from the perspective of a customer of Orange, the main French telecom operator. The contract he has with the historic operator corresponds to a classic bilateral transaction — that is to say, a successfully singularized service: the user’s attachment to his telephone and the actions it allows convinced him to consent to pay the monthly amount required.

This outcome is the culmination of a series of framings that led to the transfer of rights in return for payment: first the market attachment (which triggers the consent to pay), then the accepted formulation of a price (the subscription fee, which frequently implies a multiyear subscription), and finally payments, which fulfill the transaction.

Free arrived on the scene and offered lower prices while barely modifying services. The offer was based on a simple finding: the user’s attachment to the mobile telephone — and the courses of action the device allows — is largely irreversible. Furthermore, this situation was achieved by a slew of French operators (SFR, Bouygues, Orange, and . . . Free), but it is not controlled by any of them. The telephone is a platform, and the operator is only one of its many contributors. Of course, the telephone would be nothing without the cell towers and without the quality of communications supported and ensured by the different operators, but it also would be nothing without the web, the Apple Store, Google Play, the innumerable apps and services to which it gives access, or the geolocalization satellites. The plan that describes the good that an operator is offering is but one element in a complex and evolving device

that would have no value in the customer’s eyes if that device were to falter or disappear. One can say that the plan opens up a new step in perpetuating the singularization process. Following this strategy, the new operator piggybacks on a vast number of past investments that make the success of the plan possible, yet without having to fight or pay for them. By slashing prices, Free does not challenge the singularization process as a whole. It is not offering the exact same plan at a lower price. Rather, it offers a plan that is more singularized
because

it is cheaper. There is no guarantee that this singularization strategy will work, of course. It works only if this new quality (the price) makes it possible to capture customers and attach them durably by detaching them from other operators and by getting them to fulfill the terms of contract.
不妨考察移动电话服务商的案例：1999年，一家新运营商 Free 以激进的商业策略进入法国市场。让我们从法国主要电信运营商 Orange 的一位客户的角度来看待此事。他与这家传统主导运营商所订立的合同，对应着一笔经典的双边交易——也就是说，一项被成功独一化的服务：用户对其电话以及电话所允许的种种行动的附着，使他确信应当同意支付所需的月费。
这一结果乃是一系列框定的顶点，正是这些框定促成了以付款换取权利转移：首先是市场附着（它触发支付的同意），然后是被接受的价格构式（月租费，它常常意味着多年的订购承诺），最后是实际付款，交易由此完成。

Free 登场，提供更低的价格，却几乎不改变服务。这一要约建立在一个简单的发现之上：用户对移动电话——以及该设备所允许的行动路线——的附着，在很大程度上是不可逆的。此外，这一局面是由一众法国运营商（SFR、布依格〔Bouygues〕、Orange，以及……Free）共同造就的，却没有一家能够控制它。电话是一个平台，运营商只是其众多贡献者之一。当然，没有基站，没有各运营商所支持并保障的通信质量，电话将无所作为；但同样，没有网络、苹果商店（Apple Store）、谷歌应用商店（Google Play）、它所接入的无数应用与服务，以及地理定位卫星，电话也将无所作为。描述运营商所提供之物品的方案（plan，此处指资费与服务的组合），只是一个复杂而不断演化的装置
中的一个要素；倘若这一装置动摇或消失，该方案在客户眼中便毫无价值。可以说，这一方案开启了使独一化过程得以延续的新一步。遵循这一策略，新运营商搭上了大量既往投资的便车——正是这些投资使该方案的成功成为可能，而它却无须为之争夺或付费。通过大幅削价，Free 并未挑战作为整体的独一化过程。它并不是以更低的价格提供完全相同的方案。毋宁说，它提供的方案
因其
更便宜而更加独一化。当然，并无保证这一独一化策略一定奏效。它只有在这样一种情况下才奏效：这一新的品质（价格）能够俘获客户，并通过使他们脱离其他运营商、促使他们履行合同条款，而将他们持久地附着住。

Am I going against common sense or betraying a taste for paradox by saying that Free participates in intensifying singularization, rather than engaging in a classical standardization strategy? After a period of intensive innovation and nonprice competition, is there not a move, as is often the case, to a period of price competition? No, because this distinction, which has been overused, only superficially captures the process in question. With or without Free’s slashed prices, the mobile telephone remains a highly singularized good. Given its insertion in a sociotechnical device that is constantly evolving, it leads its user into a conjoined movement that openly reconfigures identities. What is called price competition is only the tip of the iceberg: its conditions of possibility depend entirely on the powerful movement of singularization that carries it. By opting for Free, I reconfirm my attachment to a mobile phone, one of whose qualities has been modified in a way that suits me: its price. A long series of continuous investments is necessary to make price a discriminant quality.
Free does not herald the reign of desingularization (or standardization), but rather a continuation of the intensification of singularization and its consolidation. It is because the customer is
already
attached and has
already
been led to the point at which he consents to pay that, helped by many comparative reviews and assistant calculators, he can succumb to comparing prices and making a decision on that basis.

我说 Free 参与的是独一化的强化，而非采取一种经典的标准化的策略，这是否违背常识，或暴露了一种偏好悖论的趣味？在一段密集创新与非价格竞争之后，难道不会像通常那样，转向一个价格竞争的时期吗？不会，因为这一被过度使用的区分，只能表面地把握所涉过程。无论有没有 Free 的大幅削价，移动电话都仍然是一种高度独一化的物品。由于被置入一个不断演化的社会技术装置，它把用户带入一场公开重构身份的共同运动。所谓价格竞争不过是冰山一角：其可能性条件完全依赖于承载它的那股强大的独一化运动。通过选择 Free，我重新确认了自己对一部手机的附着，而这部手机的诸多品质中有一项已以适合我的方式被修改：它的价格。要使价格成为一项判别性的品质，需要一长串持续不断的投资。
Free 并不预示去独一化（或标准化）的统治，而是独一化之强化的延续及其巩固。正因为客户
已经
附着，并且
已经
被引导到同意支付的地步，他才可能在众多比较评测与辅助计算器的帮助下，屈服于价格比较，并在此基础上作出决定。

In any case, when price as a quality becomes a crucial variable on a trajectory of singularization, a new episode in the struggle to capture clients often begins. The formulations that Free proposes provoke counterformulations that attempt to reorient the singularization process, endeavoring to reduce price to the status of one among many other qualities. More and more plans with different prices and different services appear. Comparison tools, with their multicriteria tables, proliferate. The mobile phone is a constantly evolving good whose applications and uses are diversifying and feeding into singularization strategies.
无论如何，当价格作为一种品质成为独一化轨迹上的关键变量时，争夺客户之斗争的新一幕往往便开始了。Free 所提出的各种构式激起种种反构式，后者试图重新定向独一化过程，力图把价格贬为众多其他品质之一。越来越多的方案，带着不同的价格与不同的服务出现。比较工具及其多标准表格大量涌现。手机是一种不断演化的物品，其应用与用途日益多样化，并为独一化策略提供养料。
To better understand the logic of this dynamic, one need only recall the double meaning of the word
affectation
in French.
At the moment when I am
affected
by (
affecté par
) the position of the needle showing that my gas tank is almost empty as I am driving on the highway, I find myself
assigned
to (
affecté à
) one of the gas stations whose prices are displayed on my navigation software app. Likewise, it is because I am
affected
by the estrangement of one of my old friends who moved to Toulouse, and because I feel the need to visit him, that I find myself
assigned
to (
affecté à
) airline transportation and that I come across the service offered by Air France or EasyJet. As all those who have studied situations of
sociotechnical lock-in

have clearly seen, in such circumstances, I am not really free to refuse the mobile phone, airline transportation, or fuel. This same story of attachment devices and the conjoined evolution of the profiles of goods and agencies continues to unfold. At a certain point, this leaves price the only discriminating quality left in play and the potential customer an agency that has been progressively configured in such a way as to be sensitive only to price. If, having been thus formatted, I choose Free, Carrefour, and EasyJet, I can rejoice in having gotten a good deal, in having made a good calculation. This movement — which makes price into a quality that, in affecting me (
m’affecté par
), assigns me to (
m’affecte à

) EasyJet, Carrefour or Free — could not be prolonged if it did not maintain and extend the affectations/assignments that preceded it and that made me unable to do without the cell phone, the car, or the plane. Thus, the result of intensive singularization through prices is not that the consumer is finally led to enter the realm of rational calculation, but that he let himself be carried by the
affectio mercatus
that leads him, in this case, to consider price a crucial characteristic. The price competition is nothing but one particular and (very often) transitional modality of the competition over qualities.
要更好地理解这一动态的逻辑，只需回想法语中
affectation
一词的双重含义。
当我驾车行驶在高速公路上，受到表明油箱几乎见底的指针位置的
感发
affecté par
）的那一刻，我便发现自己
被指派
affecté à
）到导航软件应用上显示着价格的那些加油站之一。同样，正是因为我因与一位移居图卢兹的老友相隔遥远而受到
感发
，并且因为我觉得需要去看望他，我才发现自己
被指派
affecté à
）给航空运输，并遇上法国航空（Air France）或易捷航空（EasyJet）所提供的服务。正如所有研究过社会技术锁定（
sociotechnical lock-in

）情境的人都清楚地看到的那样，在这种情形下，我并非真的可以自由拒绝手机、航空运输或燃油。同样这部关于附着装置以及物品与能动者的特征构型共同演化的故事，仍在继续展开。到了某个节点，这便使价格成为唯一仍在起作用的判别性品质，并使潜在客户成为一种逐步被配置得只对价格敏感的能动者。如果经过如此格式化之后，我选择了 Free、家乐福（Carrefour）和易捷航空，我尽可以为做了一笔划算的买卖、做了一次出色的计算而欢欣。这一运动——它把价格变成这样一种品质：在使我受到感发（
m’affecté par
）的同时，把我指派给（
m’affecte à
）易捷航空、家乐福或 Free——倘若不维持并扩展那些先行于它、使我离不开手机、汽车或飞机的感发／指派，便无法延续。因此，通过价格进行的密集独一化，其结果并不是消费者最终被引入理性计算的领域，而是他让自己被市场情动（
affectio mercatus
）所承载；在此情形下，这种情动引导他把价格视为一项关键特征。价格竞争不过是品质之争的一种特殊且（往往）过渡性的样态。
HOW PRICE BECOMES A TOOL FOR RANKING
价格如何成为一种排序工具

The price of a kilo of sirloin can vary in a ratio of one to two, depending on the vendor and the location. This is an enigma that requires explanation. Some will postulate that differences in quality account for the difference in price. Others will suggest that one butcher is twice the thief. Yet others will argue that some consumers accept the higher price because it distinguishes them from the others. Neither the inquiries and investigations to support one thesis or another nor their answers matter much to me. What interests me is that the prices, which emerge from the series of rankings produced by instruments of evaluation, are themselves in turn powerful and extraordinarily simple tools for ranking goods, sellers, or buyers. These tools are all the more powerful because they can be applied across all commercial goods.

一公斤西冷牛排的价格可以在一比二的比例内变动，视卖主与地点而定。这是一个有待解释的谜。有人会假定，品质的差异解释了价格的差异。有人则会说，某个肉贩宰客的程度是另一个的两倍。还有人会主张，某些消费者接受较高的价格，是因为这使他们区别于其他人。无论支持这一或那一论点的探究与调查，还是它们给出的答案，对我都不太重要。我感兴趣的是：这些价格从评价工具所生产的一系列排序中浮现出来，而它们本身又反过来成为对物品、卖主或买主进行排序的强有力且极其简单的工具。这些工具之所以更加强有力，是因为它们可以适用于所有商业物品。

With prices, comparison does not necessarily remain within a single class of products that were circumscribed by the underlying price formulations. Through prices, it becomes possible to compare and rank goods that had not been compared and ranked before. Not only can we say that this bottle of a great vintage represents a day’s work at minimum wage; one can also say that its relative position in the class of bottles of wine is comparable to the relative position of an Audi Q5 in the class of SUVs. One ends up producing scales, which paves the way to constructing hierarchized classifications of people. For instance, out of these rankings, a class of consumers might emerge who buy great vintages and high-end SUVs and who vacation on fabulous exclusive islands. The existence of what Bourdieu calls
structural homology
can be explained as the more or less stable outcomes of this complex process of classification, which is already a classic object of analysis within sociology.

借助价格，比较未必仍局限于由底层的价格构式所划定的单一产品类别之内。通过价格，比较和排序那些此前从未被比较和排序过的物品成为可能。我们不仅可以说，这瓶上佳年份的葡萄酒相当于最低工资下一整天的劳动；还可以说，它在葡萄酒类别中的相对位置，可与一辆奥迪 Q5 在 SUV 类别中的相对位置相比。人们最终生产出了量表，而这为建构人的等级化分类铺平了道路。例如，从这些排序中可能浮现出一类消费者：他们购买上佳年份酒与高端 SUV，并在迷人的专属岛屿上度假。布迪厄（Bourdieu）所称的结构同源性（
structural homology
）之所以存在，可以被解释为这一复杂分类过程或多或少稳定的产物；而这一过程早已是社会学的经典分析对象。

The effects of these rankings cannot be considered as isolated phenomena. They are the last step in a series of operations through which price formulation is performed. The price, which is but one particular quality of the good, is transformed into an autonomous variable that engenders social classifications. This reversal, neglected by the market interface model, is at the heart of market agencements. In order to explain how this reversal happens, it is worth devoting a few lines to the conceptual distinction that describes the dual nature of measuring, expressed in French by the terms
mesure mesurée
and
mesure mesurante
这些排序的效应不能被当作孤立的现象。它们是价格构式得以实施的一系列操作中的最后一步。价格原本只是物品的一项特定品质，却被转化为一个自主变量，催生出社会分类。这一颠倒被界面市场模型所忽视，却处于市场装配的核心。为解释这一颠倒如何发生，值得用几行文字讨论一个概念区分：它描述测量的双重性质，在法语中以
mesure mesurée
（被测量的测量）与
mesure mesurante
（进行测量的测量）这两个术语来表达。

To illustrate this distinction, let me refer to the well-known case of what is called intellectual quotient or IQ. First the notion of intelligence had to be defined (by experts) as a set of dimensions and subdimensions that were supposed to capture the underlying trait. In a second step, scales for each of these dimensions or subdimensions were constituted. Next, each scale was qualified, and finally, hierarchized classes were produced. So defined, the quotient allowed us to begin speaking of levels of intelligence. Finally, tests were designed to organize the exploration, quantification, and hierarchization of this intelligence, resulting in the expression of IQ through numbers (for example: 100, 120, 140 . . . ) that correspond to the underlying process of constructing this way of capturing intelligence —
mesure mesurée
. From there follows the process of deploying the measurement as a tool —
mesure mesurante

— during which the qualculation behind the IQ (that is, the choice of dimensions, proxies, tests, and so on) could be simply black-boxed. IQ can now be used as an alleged neutral instrument measuring a reality that can consequently be seen as objective.

为说明这一区分，让我援引所谓智力商数或智商（IQ）这一众所周知的例子。首先，必须（由专家）把智力这一概念界定为一组维度与子维度，人们假定这些维度能够捕捉那一底层特质。第二步，为这些维度或子维度中的每一个构建量表。接着，对每一量表进行品质界定，最后生产出等级化的类别。如此界定之后，这一商数使我们得以开始谈论智力的水平。最后，设计出测试，以组织对智力的探索、量化与等级化，最终使智商以数字（例如：100、120、140……）的形式表达出来；这些数字对应着建构这种捕捉智力之方式的底层过程——
mesure mesurée
。由此便进入把测量作为工具加以部署的过程——
mesure mesurante
——在此过程中，智商背后的质算（即对维度、代理指标、测试等等的选择）可以被简单地黑箱化。如今，智商可以被用作一种据称中立的工具，测量一种由此便被视为客观的现实。

It is like using any kind of yardstick. When I say: “The length of this table is one meter,” I don’t care how meter as a unit has been defined and how the tool I have in my hands has been produced. What matters for me is simply the statement “The length is one meter,” even though it could be alternatively be stated as “The length is thirty-nine inches.” The same is true with IQ. What is measured by IQ is simply one definition of “intelligence.” From an analytically construed term, intelligence manages to become an objective and indisputable entity. Instead of being the outcome of IQ testing (designed as a
mesure mesurée
), intelligence becomes what is measured by IQ (conceived of as a
mesure mesurante

). This (classic) reversal allows us to understand why this specific tool can be interpreted as an instrument of (social) classification and stratification: people can be grouped according to their intelligence as measured by the tests. This tool contributes to structuring social life: it transforms the definition (the assembled components that make up this definition of intelligence) into an objective attribute (the intelligence of the tested persons). The effects engendered by such tools cannot be denied or dismissed; instead, they must be carefully described and analyzed.

这就像使用任何一种量尺。当我说“这张桌子的长度是一米”时，我并不关心“米”作为一个单位是如何被定义的，也不关心我手中的工具是如何被生产出来的。对我而言，重要的仅仅是“长度为一米”这一陈述，尽管它本来也可以被表述为“长度为三十九英寸”。智商也是如此。智商所测量的，只不过是“智力”的某一种定义。智力原本是一个分析性建构的术语，却得以变成一种客观而无可争议的实体。智力不再被视为智商测试的结果（测试被设计为一种
被测量的测量
），反而变成了智商所测量的东西（智商被设想为一种
进行测量的测量
）。这一（经典的）颠倒使我们能够理解，为何这一特定工具可以被解释为一种（社会）分类与分层的工具：人们可以按照测试所测量的智力而被分组。这一工具参与塑造社会生活的结构：它把定义（构成这一智力定义的各组装成分）转化为一种客观属性（受测者的智力）。这类工具所产生的效应不能被否认或打发掉；相反，必须仔细地描述并分析它们。

All metrological operations can be subject to this type of reversal, but prices are particularly susceptible. Having been fed by a long series of classifications (processes of price formulation), they can in turn be transformed into a tool for ranking that can be applied to goods themselves. The scoring systems used in consumer lending provide a striking illustration of this mechanism, with its different stages. Lenders (for example, banks) typically design products (loans) that differ by such qualities as, for example, the amount, duration, rate of interest, or insurance premiums. The prices of the loans whose formulation combines these characteristics are, as for any other good, nothing but a specific quality. Recall for a moment how price discriminates seats in planes or in trains: loans are just like seats or hotel rooms — they are part of a process that ends with them becoming singular. And like seats and hotel rooms, loan products are in search of clients, only in this case, the clients are borrowers.

所有计量学操作都可能遭遇这类颠倒，而价格尤其容易如此。价格曾由一长串分类（价格构式过程）所滋养，而它们反过来又可以转化为一种可应用于物品本身的排序工具。消费信贷中所使用的评分系统，为这一机制及其不同阶段提供了一个醒目的例证。放贷者（例如银行）通常设计出在产品品质上有所不同的产品（贷款），这些品质例如金额、期限、利率或保险费。这些贷款的价格由上述特征组合而构式；与任何其他物品一样，它也不过是一项特定品质。不妨回想一下价格如何区分飞机或火车上的座位：贷款就像座位或酒店客房——它们都是一个以自身成为独一之物而告终的过程的一部分。而且，和座位与酒店客房一样，贷款产品也在寻找客户，只不过在此情形下，客户是借款人。

In Anglo-Saxon countries (the United States and Britain), organizing encounters between singularized loan products and potential borrowers was made possible by information intermediaries called credit bureaus, which date back to the nineteenth century. In the beginning, credit bureaus collected information on business operators in view of transmitting it to possible transaction partners.

A trading entity could consult these bureaus to find out whether this or that counterpart had a reputation for paying their bills. Later, small, local bureaus emerged that did this work for households. Today, consumer credit bureaus equipped with electronic databases continue to gather publicly available information on individuals and banks, establishing synthetic documents that report on things such as outstanding loan amounts and legal proceedings incurred and keeping a record of all those who have requested access to these documents in the last two years. In this system, the information about individual market participants is a commodity. Institutions that underwrite loans, employers, insurance agencies, public administrations, and more broadly, any organism that can justify a business interest in this information, such as a landlord, can all have access to this information.
在盎格鲁-撒克逊国家（美国与英国），独一化的贷款产品与潜在借款人之间的相遇之所以能够被组织起来，得益于被称为征信机构（credit bureaus）的信息中介，其历史可追溯至19世纪。起初，征信机构收集关于商人的信息，以便将其传递给可能的交易伙伴。

一家交易机构可以查询这些征信机构，以弄清某个交易对手是否有按时付款的名声。后来，出现了为家庭从事这项工作的本地小型征信机构。如今，配备电子数据库的消费信贷征信机构继续收集关于个人与银行的公开可得信息，编制综合文件，报告未偿贷款金额、所涉法律诉讼等事项，并记录过去两年内所有曾请求查阅这些文件的人。在这一体系中，关于个别市场参与者的信息是一种商品。承销贷款的机构、雇主、保险机构、公共行政部门，以及更宽泛地说，任何能够证明自己对这些信息有商业利益的机构——例如房东——都可以获取这些信息。

As Martha Poon has documented, what is known publicly in the United States as a FICO score is a trademarked product, developed on the back of the previously competitive underlying information commodity (the credit record at the bureau), that has had far more utility to lenders in their own financial product development than rich, unfiltered credit files. The American FICO score does not consider income level, employment situation, civil status, age, or address, even though those variables are central to the scores developed in other places, such as France.

Marketing materials tell us that FICO is calculated based on payment history (35 percent), level of outstanding commitments (30 percent), recent credit history (15 percent), type of loans held (10 percent), and new loans (10 percent), and it summarizes all of this information in the form of a number on a scale that lies between 300 and 850. Scores sold in a competitive marketplace for information, but all provided by FICO on a common scale, radically transformed US credit by permitting a mass market for credit cards to emerge in which credit was itself a product detached from banking relationships or retail transactions. Instead of waiting for people to approach them to borrow, using FICO, lenders were actively able to issue unsolicited credit card offers by dipping into the bureaus like a dating service to find or match people to whom they wish to create a credit attachment. A matching platform, FICO is an exploratorium device similar to those presented in Chapter 4. When a match is fulfilled, what has been achieved is the establishment of a singular relationship between a packaged product (including its price) and a unique borrower, a relationship that is made possible through the FICO intermediary.
正如玛莎·潘（Martha Poon）所记录的那样，在美国公众所熟知的 FICO 评分，是一种注册商标产品；它建立在先前具有竞争性的底层信息商品（征信机构中的信用记录）之上，对放贷者开发自身金融产品而言，其实用性远远超过丰富而未经过滤的信用档案。美国的 FICO 评分不考虑收入水平、就业状况、婚姻状况、年龄或住址，尽管这些变量对于其他地方（例如法国）所开发的评分而言至关重要。

营销材料告诉我们，FICO 的计算依据是：还款历史（35%）、未偿债务水平（30%）、信用记录时长（15%）、所持贷款类型（10%）以及新贷款（10%）；它把所有这些信息概括为一个数字，其量表介于 300 与 850 之间。这些评分在竞争性的信息市场上出售，但全部由 FICO 按共同量表提供；它们彻底改变了美国的信贷，使信用卡的大众市场得以出现——在这个市场中，信贷本身成了一种脱离银行关系或零售交易的产品。放贷者不再坐等人们上门借贷；借助 FICO，他们能够主动发出未经请求的信用卡要约，像使用约会服务那样深入征信机构的数据库，寻找或匹配他们希望与之建立信贷附着的人。FICO 是一个匹配平台，是一种类似于第四章所呈现的那些装置的探索场装置。当匹配达成时，所实现的是在一个打包产品（包括其价格）与一位独一无二的借款人之间建立起独一的关系，而这一关系正是通过 FICO 这一中介才得以可能。

What must be clear is that the lenders are not especially interested in the borrowers as individuals. In order to manage credit as a mass-production process, what matters are the summary scores in the same way that for people looking for soul mates, what matters up front are profiles. The business of lenders is to underwrite product offerings that are adapted to the different score groups and that are simultaneously attractive to the collection of individuals who correspond to that score group. Once the transaction is complete, the aggregate product must also allow lenders to achieve the business objectives they are pursuing (for example, optimizing income, minimizing the risks of nonpayment, and so on). The definition of the qualities of loans is always in the hands of the lenders. There is a vast variety of possible configurations, or in the language of this book, loan profiles. Yet they can all be aligned on a seemingly seamless continuum, from loans with many options for high amounts of capital with lower interest rates to loans with fewer options for lower sums with higher interest rates. We all intuitively understand that the former are usually designed for higher scores and the latter, which under uncapped interest rates are just as lucrative a business, for lower scores.

必须明确的是，放贷者并不特别关心作为个体的借款人。为了把信贷作为大规模生产过程来管理，重要的是那些概括性的评分，正如对于寻找灵魂伴侣的人来说，首先重要的是个人档案。放贷者的业务，是承销那些适应不同评分群体的产品供给，同时这些产品又对与该评分群体相对应的个体集合具有吸引力。一旦交易完成，这一汇总产品还必须使放贷者能够实现其所追求的商业目标（例如优化收入、最小化不付款的风险，等等）。贷款品质的定义始终掌握在放贷者手中。可能的配置多种多样，或者用本书的语言说，即贷款特征构型（loan profiles）。然而，它们都可以被排列在一个看似无缝的连续统上：从高额资金、较多选项、较低利率的贷款，到低额资金、较少选项、较高利率的贷款。我们都直觉地理解：前者通常是为较高评分设计的，而后者——在利率不设上限的情况下，同样是一门有利可图的生意——则是为较低评分设计的。

Although the topic feels well understood, the clarifications I am making are essential. They shed light on the too often unrecognized reversal mechanism that is the core of this section. Like IQs, the FICO score can be considered in two different ways. First, it is a way of producing measurement (
mesure mesurée

). Indeed, from the different dimensions and subdimensions that Fair, Isaac selects and quantifies, FICO scores define a space that makes it possible to create loans, qualified in part by their level of score. A class of loans corresponds to a given range of FICO values and therefore allows the market to group together types of loans with similar characteristics (amounts, interest rate, duration, and so on), even if they are not originated by the same lender. FICO then acts to project its measurement (
mesure mesurante

): outside the mechanics of loan production, the FICO score can be used to characterize and rank people on a linear scale. The FICO score, an index calculated from multiple qualities found in credit data and specific to the credit system, is now seen as a unidimensional scale. From a tool designed to aptly synthetize credit data for the design of mass credit products, it has been readily transformed into an instrument that classifies and hierarchizes human beings.
尽管这一主题让人觉得已被充分理解，我所作的澄清仍然至关重要。它们照亮了本节核心的那个常常未被认出的颠倒机制。与智商一样，FICO 评分可以从两种不同的方式来考虑。首先，它是一种生产测量的方式（
mesure mesurée
）。的确，从费尔·艾萨克（Fair, Isaac）所选并量化的各个维度与子维度出发，FICO 评分界定出一个空间，使创建贷款成为可能；这些贷款部分地由其评分水平而被界定品质。一类贷款对应着给定的 FICO 数值区间，因而使市场得以把特征相似（金额、利率、期限等等）的贷款类型归并在一起，即使它们并非由同一放贷者发起。随后，FICO 便着手投射其测量（
mesure mesurante
）：在贷款生产的机制之外，FICO 评分可以被用来在一条线性量表上刻画并排序人。FICO 评分这一指数由信用数据中的多种品质计算而来，且为信贷系统所特有，如今却被视为一个单维量表。它原本是一种为设计大众信贷产品而恰当综合信用数据的工具，如今却轻易地被转化为一种对人类进行分类并等级化的工具。
Once this reversal has taken place, it is obviously tempting to seek out the meaning that lies behind this unidimensional ranking. In the case of IQs, the interpretation seems simple. IQ (as a
mesure mesurée

) measures the intelligence of the people to whom the tests are applied. These people can therefore be ranked according to a single quality: their level of intelligence as measured by the tests. In the case of the FICO index, figuring out what the reduction to a single dimension could mean has collapsed back to the nineteenth-century character trait called “creditworthiness,” as if the name for this somewhat arbitrary numerical aggregation of heterogeneous characteristics were timeless.
一旦这一颠倒发生，人们显然会忍不住去探寻这一单维排序背后所隐藏的意义。就智商而言，解释似乎很简单。智商（作为一种
被测量的测量
）测量的是接受测试者的智力。因此，这些人可以按照单一品质被排序：即测试所测量的他们的智力水平。就 FICO 指数而言，要弄清这种化约为单一维度究竟可能意味着什么，却又回落到19世纪那种被称为“信用度”（creditworthiness）的性格特质上，仿佛这个对异质特征所作某种任意数值聚合的名称是超时间的。

Though as endlessly debated, the meaning of the FICO score is far from obvious. First, since its aim is the qualification of the goods on offer (loans), the FICO score is not bound to take into account any of the sociographic data usually selected to qualify people, such as socioprofessional categories, income, lifestyles, and so on. To characterize borrowers more directly, lenders must supplement the calculation of the score by returning to the raw credit file data. Once they have succeeded in attracting and attaching a client base, lenders can also gather additional information and can therefore elaborate sociological or psychological descriptions of their clientele and use them for their own purposes, particularly to gain an advantage over their competitors.

尽管人们对此争论不休，FICO 评分的意义却远非显而易见。首先，由于它的目标是界定所提供物品（贷款）的品质，FICO 评分并不必然考虑通常被选来界定人之品质的任何社会人口数据，例如社会职业类别、收入、生活方式等等。为了更直接地刻画借款人，放贷者必须回到原始的信用档案数据，以此补充评分的计算。一旦成功吸引并附着住一个客户群，放贷者还可以收集额外信息，因而能够对其客户群作出社会学或心理学的描述，并将这些描述用于自身目的，特别是用以在与竞争者的较量中取得优势。

Needless to say, it is mainly social scientists who are engaging in this work of repurposing FICO scores to directly classify agents. For example, economic sociologists Marion Fourcade and Kieran Healy have convincingly shown that the Weberian notion of
life chance

, the probability that someone’s life will turn out in a particular way, could be correlated with FICO scores and therefore with the types of loans sold by lenders and particularly with their prices. Once this result is obtained, the sociological analysis can then be pursued and arrive at statements such as the following: by using the FICO score, lenders offer to populations living in difficult conditions loans whose characteristics, and in particular prices, only worsen these conditions.
毋庸赘言，主要是一些社会科学家在从事这项工作：把 FICO 评分挪作他用，以直接对行动者进行分类。例如，经济社会学家玛丽昂·富尔卡德（Marion Fourcade）与基兰·希利（Kieran Healy）令人信服地表明，韦伯式的生活机会（
life chance
）概念——即某人的生活将以某种特定方式展开的概率——可以与 FICO 评分相关联，因而也可以与放贷者所售贷款的类别相关联，尤其与这些贷款的价格相关联。一旦得到这一结果，社会学分析便可以继续推进，得出如下论断：放贷者借助 FICO 评分，向生活在困难境况中的人群提供这样的贷款——其特征、尤其是价格，只会使这些境况进一步恶化。

As I said before, my purpose here is not to discuss the robustness or the relevance of this type of statement. It is simply to highlight the reversal mechanism that on the basis of an index leads to the qualification of the people with whom it is associated. Instead of being considered as a definition (always perfectible or modifiable) of intelligence, IQ is used as a tool to discriminate people who find themselves classified according to what is now considered to be their intelligence. The
mesure mesurante
takes precedence over the
mesure mesurée

. This movement, in the case of FICO scores, is all the more effective since its definition is a commercial black box, which is not the case with IQ. A FICO score becomes part of an environment that imposes itself and is discursively imposed as an indisputable reality on customers. It is easy to understand why the social sciences are so interested in this kind of configuration, especially as scoring practices calculated through proprietary systems become more widespread.
如我先前所说，我在此的目的并不是讨论这类论断的稳健性或相关性。而仅仅是凸显这一颠倒机制：它以一个指数为基础，导向对与该指数相关联的人的品质界定。智商不再被视为对智力的一种（永远可完善或可修改的）定义，而是被用作一种区分人的工具，这些人发现自己按照如今被视为其智力的东西而被分类。
进行测量的测量
压倒了
被测量的测量
。就 FICO 评分而言，这一运动之所以格外有效，是因为其定义是一个商业黑箱，而智商的情况并非如此。FICO 评分成为一个强加于人的环境的一部分，并在话语上作为一种无可争议的现实被强加给客户。不难理解，为何社会科学对这类配置如此感兴趣，尤其是当通过专有系统计算的评分实践日益普及时。
I have discussed the dual property of measurement systems at length because it is a mechanism that paves the way to the notion of quality, singular without an
s

. But why discuss the notion of quality at this point? Above all because this notion is constantly invoked by agents themselves to explain price differences between products considered as belonging to the same family, as for example when one speaks of the quality/price ratio.

Quality is considered to be measured, in a practical way, by price: quality is what the price is supposed to measure. This alleged one-to-one correspondence obviously leaves room for controversies and contradictory appraisals. But whatever it may be, what is assumed to exist as a hidden attribute of goods, named quality, is what prices should discover or express. Prices can now be seen as an intermediate variable between goods and consumers. They, too, transform a good’s ranking into a ranking of people.
我之所以详加讨论测量系统的双重属性，是因为这一机制为 quality（品质）这一单数概念——不带
s
的单数——铺平了道路。但为何在此讨论品质这一概念？首先是因为，行动者自己不断援引这一概念来解释被视为同属一个家族的产品之间的价格差异，例如当人们谈到性价比（quality/price ratio）的时候。
品质被认为以某种实践的方式由价格来衡量：品质正是价格理应衡量的东西。这种所谓的逐一对应显然为争议与相互矛盾的评估留出了空间。但无论如何，那种被假定为物品之隐藏属性而存在、名为品质的东西，正是价格应当发现或表达的东西。如今，价格可以被视为物品与消费者之间的一个中介变量。价格同样把物品的排序转化为人的排序。
FORMULATIONS ARE EVERYWHERE
构式无处不在
The activity of price formulation is a fairly recent subject of study. Nevertheless, there is very detailed work on the role played by those known in France as engineer-economists.

In many countries, their contribution has been (and still is) decisive in sectors such as electricity, telecommunications, and transportation. The numerous controversies their formulas have given rise to are well documented.
The same goes for financial markets and for the markets for insurance and reinsurance, which have long since become choice sites for formulas.
Studies by Sandrine Barrey have shown, against all expectation, that very elaborate formulas are conceived and used in distribution sectors where prices are strictly regulated.
In a very innovative book, François Vatin widens the analysis to a great range of lines of business.

Several authors make direct reference to the notions of formulas and formulations in order to show how prices are calculated — for example, in the case of financing company projects or setting unemployment compensation for part-time workers in the entertainment industry.
价格构式活动作为研究对象，出现得相当晚近。尽管如此，关于在法国被称为“工程师—经济学家”（ingénieurs-économistes）的那些人所扮演的角色，已有非常细致的研究。
在许多国家，他们的贡献在电力、电信与交通运输等部门曾经是（如今依然是）决定性的。他们的公式所引发的众多争议，已有详尽记载。
金融市场以及保险与再保险市场也是如此；这些市场早已成为公式大显身手的场所。
桑德琳·巴雷（Sandrine Barrey）的研究出人意料地表明，在价格受到严格管制的分销部门，极为精致的公式被构想出来并加以使用。
弗朗索瓦·瓦坦（François Vatin）在一本极具创新性的著作中，把分析扩展到众多行业。
若干作者直接援引公式与构式的概念，以说明价格如何被计算出来——例如在公司项目融资，或为演艺业间歇性工作者确定失业补偿的情形中。
It is worth noting that this formulation work is present in unexpected areas. For example, we are starting to have access to the secrets of the art market and the market for great vintages.

Juan Pablo Pardo-Guerra’s work on auction-house companies is one illustration. Having followed the sale of famous works, he makes the qualculations that precede the auction itself explicit, notably underlining the importance of producing and distributing catalogs of the items for sale, which, according to him, are powerful tools in price formulation.
值得注意的是，这种构式工作也存在于出人意料的领域。例如，我们开始得以一窥艺术市场与名贵年份酒市场的秘密。
胡安·巴勃罗·帕尔多—格拉（Juan Pablo Pardo-Guerra）关于拍卖行公司的研究便是一例。他追踪名作的销售过程，把拍卖本身之前所进行的质算揭示出来，尤其强调制作与分发待售物品图录的重要性；在他看来，图录是价格构式的有力工具。

Consider this entry in the catalog for a 2006 auction at Christie’s in London: “Lot 18, sale number 1619.” It corresponds to a charcoal drawing attributed to Michelangelo. The catalog gives a brief description of the work. It gives its dimensions (248 × 176 mm), then notes that it is a representation of a man’s head and torso (looking downward), as well as a study of the left shoulder and two studies of the right shoulder. The entry specifies that this work first belonged to the artist’s family in Florence, that it then moved into the hands of John Malcom of Poltalloch (1805 – 1893), who passed it on to his son, who bequeathed it to his cousin, who then sold it to its current owner at Sotheby’s in London on November 24, 1976. Through the references this biography establishes, it contributes, according to the process we saw in Chapter 2, to the good’s qualification and particularly to its authentication. The catalog does not just describe these qualities: it establishes the work’s relation to other elements, positing associations. For instance, it notes family resemblances with other works. It briefly evokes the literature devoted to Michelangelo — notably, what covers this sort of study. It gives an exhaustive list of exhibitions in which the drawing has been shown. Detailed connections are made to other Michelangelo works such as the
Pietà
in Saint Peter’s and the Christ in his
Last Judgment

. Overall, the catalog operates simultaneously as both a purveyor and an analyst of associations. It offers a precise picture of all the qualities the work possesses by virtue of the relations it is in, which are, as Pardo-Guerra underlines, retraced (and produced) by the catalog’s narrative.

请看伦敦佳士得（Christie’s）2006年一场拍卖的图录条目：“第18号拍品，拍卖编号1619。”它对应一幅被归于米开朗基罗（Michelangelo）名下的炭笔画。图录对作品作了简要描述，给出尺寸（248 × 176 毫米），随后指出画中表现的是一个低头男子的头部与躯干，此外还有左肩的一幅习作和右肩的两幅习作。条目明确记载：这件作品最初属于艺术家在佛罗伦萨的家族，后来转入波尔塔洛赫的约翰·马尔科姆（John Malcom of Poltalloch，1805—1893）之手，后者将其传给儿子，儿子又遗赠给表亲，表亲最终于1976年11月24日在伦敦苏富比（Sotheby’s）将其卖给了当时的所有者。通过这段身世所建立的诸般参照，按照我们在第二章所见的过程，它有助于物品的品质界定，尤其是其真伪鉴定。图录并不只是描述这些品质：它建立起作品与其他要素之间的关系，提出种种关联。例如，它指出作品与其他作品之间的家族相似性。它简要提及专论米开朗基罗的文献——尤其是论述这类习作的文献。它详尽列出这幅画曾参展的展览。它还与其他米开朗基罗作品建立起细致联系，例如圣彼得大教堂的《圣殇》（
Pietà
）和
《最后的审判》
中的基督。总体而言，图录同时充当关联的供给者与分析者。它凭借作品所处的关系，精确描绘出作品所拥有的一切品质；而正如帕尔多—格拉所强调的，这些关系正是由图录的叙事重新追溯（并生产）出来的。

Through the operations of classification and ordering that it authorizes, the work of cataloging corresponds to the evaluations described in Chapter 3. But it also goes beyond that. It also integrates a host of prices (
Pi
), which enable the qualculation of the price (
Pj

), which Christie estimates. These prices were paid in previous sales or were estimated by experts at different moments of the work’s life. They also include the prices (paid or estimated) of comparable works of Michelangelo’s or painters close to him. As in the case of the pieces of meat followed by Anzalone, it is impossible to distinguish the operations that determine value from those that affix the price. Value no more precedes the price than the price serves to establish the good’s value. The formulation and the different prices it combines emerge through the operations of association, classification, and ranking from which they cannot be abstracted. Conversely, the evaluation uses the price as one of the criteria, one of the qualities, on which to base its qualculation. Until one understands that the price is one among many qualities, the mechanisms of how it is affixed (of its triangulation, to use Pardo-Guerra’s suggestive term) remain mysterious and resist analysis.
通过它所促成的分类与排序操作，图录编制工作对应于第三章所描述的评价活动。但它还超出了这一层。它还整合了一大批价格（
Pi
），这些价格使佳士得所估定的价格（
Pj

）的质算成为可能。这些价格或是在此前历次交易中支付的，或是由专家在作品生涯的不同时刻估定的。它们还包括米开朗基罗本人或与其相近的画家的可比作品的价格（已支付或估算的）。正如安扎隆所追踪的肉块案例，我们无法把决定价值的操作与确定价格的操作区分开来。价值并不先于价格，正如价格并不用来确立物品的价值。构式及其所组合的各种价格，是在关联、分类与排序的操作中浮现出来的，不能从这些操作中抽象出去。反过来，评价把价格当作其据以进行质算的标准之一、品质之一。只要人们还不明白价格只是众多品质中的一种，价格如何被确定（用帕尔多—格拉那个富有启发的说法，即价格的“三角测量”）的机制就仍然神秘莫测，难以分析。

We can now see why the entry for lot 18 runs to no fewer than fifty pages, mixing price, quantitative material measures, expert reports, references to historical databases, photographs, historical context, and more. Without this descriptive inventory, the drawing would be reduced to a light sheet, weightless, and as alone as the young women from Brittany who, at the beginning of the last century, stepped off the train in the Montparnasse station. It would be as far from operational as a fighter plane whose documentation, weighing more than the plane itself, has been lost. Auction-house companies and their catalogs constitute an infrastructure whose finality is to animate the networks of associations, linkages, and evaluations that affix prices. Like the consumers we will meet shortly who negotiate the formula for the price of natural gas backed up by a
Que choisir

campaign, the client who participates in a public auction can, of course, depending on the resources available to him, negotiate the price offered by Christie’s or other bidders. In market agencements, however, the struggle is over the formulation of prices, and not over the prices themselves.

现在我们就能明白，为什么第18号拍品的条目长达五十页之多，其中混合了价格、定量的物质测量、专家报告、对历史数据库的引用、照片、历史背景等等。若没有这份描述性清单，这幅画就会被化约为一张轻薄、没有重量的纸，孤零零的，就像上世纪之初在蒙帕纳斯火车站（Montparnasse）走下火车的那些布列塔尼年轻女子。它离可操作状态之远，恰如一架丢失了重于机身本身的文档资料的战斗机。拍卖行公司及其图录构成一种基础设施，其最终目的是激活那些确定价格的关联、连接与评价网络。就像我们稍后将会遇到的、在《选择》（
Que choisir
）杂志发起的一场运动支持下就天然气价格公式展开谈判的消费者一样，参与公开拍卖的客户当然也可以依据自己可支配的资源，就佳士得或其他竞买者给出的价格进行谈判。然而，在市场装配中，斗争围绕的是价格的构式，而不是价格本身。

I cannot give an inventory of the studies that show how few areas escape this immense reflection on the practices of pricing. Furthermore, a new wave of complex mathematical formulations that migrate and disseminate has been brought on by the spread of yield management. However, to validate the hypothesis according to which prices — all prices — are formulated, I must push beyond the best-studied cases, in which the work of formulation appears in an explicit, asserted, and argued manner. I must show that it also holds for the very numerous transactions in which formulas seem to be absent and where they are essentially qualitative. In order to make this point, I turn again to Jane Guyer and her study of the Yorubas’ commercial activities. (See Chapter 2.)

我无法对相关研究一一盘点，以说明逃脱这场关于定价实践的巨大反思的领域何其稀少。此外，收益管理（yield management）的推广，又催生了一批复杂数学公式的新浪潮，它们不断迁移、扩散。然而，要验证“价格——一切价格——皆被构式”这一假设，我必须越出那些研究得最充分的案例；在这些案例中，构式工作以明确、被公开主张并得到论证的方式呈现出来。我还必须表明，这一假设同样适用于数量众多的交易：其中的公式看似缺席，实质上主要是定性的。为说明这一点，我再次转向简·盖耶（Jane Guyer）及其对约鲁巴人（Yorubas）商业活动的研究。（参见第二章。）

Appealing to the triple distinction between nominal, ordinal, and numerical scales with which the reader is now familiar, Guyer describes the process that begins with words, which serve to designate things, and that ends with numbers (prices) associated with these things. This grid of analysis allows her to follow the price-affixing mechanisms in face-to-face situations. In this case, as she tells it, the agencies who meet face a considerable task since they have to construct the framework for their interaction (how to proceed in order to organize an exchange that begins with an exchange of words) while identifying the benchmarks and reference points that will allow them to reach a price acceptable to both parties. This job is all the more important and indispensable because the transaction takes place at the margins, in border zones where no one can claim that norms or shared institutions exist, in places where, to obtain goods, there is always a hesitation between armed force, theft, brutal extortion, and gentle commerce and the switch from one regime to another sometimes comes unexpectedly. This situation is all the more interesting because the agents are not only face to face, but, furthermore, very poorly equipped, and they have only one ambition (namely, to exchange goods for payment), and a single preoccupation (namely, to affix their price). If it can be shown that prices are formulated in this case, that would constitute a decisive step toward a price theory adapted to market agencements.

盖耶借助读者现已熟悉的三重区分——名义标度、序数标度与数值标度——描述了这样一个过程：它始于用来指称事物的词语，终于与这些事物相关联的数字（价格）。这一分析框架使她得以追踪面对面情境中的定价机制。据她所述，在此情形中，相遇的诸能动者面临一项艰巨任务：他们必须搭建互动的框架（为了组织一场以词语交换开场的交换，应当如何行事），同时识别出各种基准与参照点，以便达成双方都能接受的价格。这项工作之所以格外重要、不可或缺，是因为交易发生在边缘处，发生在无人能够声称存在规范或共享制度的边界地带；在这些地方，为了获得物品，人们始终在武力、盗窃、粗暴勒索与温和商业之间犹豫不决，而从一种体制转向另一种体制有时来得猝不及防。这一情境之所以格外有趣，还因为行动者不仅面对面，而且装备极其简陋；他们只有一个抱负（即以物品换取付款），只有一桩心事（即确定自己的价格）。若能证明价格在此情形中也是被构式的，那将构成迈向一种适用于市场装配的价格理论的决定性一步。
Guyer shows that agents affix prices by skillfully combining three scales. In one place, for instance, the Yorubas use the word
ackie

to refer to a good that corresponds to a weight of gold whose worth is 480 cauris. (A cauri is a shell used as money.) In this remarkable case, the word used to refer to a good is its price, which is the simplest way to affix the price. The strategy used corresponds exactly to the line-pricing strategy mentioned earlier (“Everything for one euro”): what is bought is a price as much as a good, and the price is therefore simply one of the good’s qualities. Translations do not end there, because moving from one dialect to another, one can play with words in an even more subtle way by varying values. For instance, a good that here is called
ackie
, is called
soa
, or
gro
, or even
mithqual
elsewhere, these terms designating either different gold weights, going from 0.05 to 0.15 ounces, or equally different numbers of cauris, from 480 to 1,200.
In this case, the formula that, through successive translations, establishes a relation of identity between words operates a conversion from a price system associated with another place (
j
) by providing the
Pj
corresponding to the original
Pi

A series of equivalences is thus established, making commensurable what was not and offering several solutions to the insoluble problem of the monetary measure of exchanged goods. The chain is endless. These measures are in turn translated into different ethnic numbering systems in base twelve. For example, the
mithqual
is equivalent to twelve hundred, as defined by Muslims, and to twelve times eighty, in the Bambara numerical system.

To put it starkly, it is as though, for instance, the word “hundred” that we use daily without there being ambiguity did not have the same value everywhere, even though it was understood everywhere, corresponding to the numbers “hundred” or “eighty” in our numbering system, depending on place and interlocutors. This new translation extends the job of conversion and complicates price formulation.
盖耶表明，行动者通过巧妙组合三种标度来确定价格。例如，在某个地方，约鲁巴人用
ackie

一词来指称一种物品，它对应一定重量的黄金，价值为480个 cauri。（cauri 是一种用作货币的贝壳。）在这一引人注目的案例中，用来指称物品的词就是它的价格——这是确定价格的最简单方式。这种做法与前文提到的统一定价策略（line pricing，即“样样一欧元”）完全吻合：所买到的既是一件物品，也同样是一个价格，因此价格干脆就是物品的一种品质。转译并未止步于此，因为从一个方言转到另一个方言，人们可以通过变换数值，以更为微妙的方式玩弄词语。例如，在此地被称为
ackie
的物品，在别处被称作
soa
gro
，甚至
mithqual
；这些词所指的，要么是不同重量的黄金（从0.05到0.15盎司），要么是不同数量的 cauri（从480到1200）。
在此情形中，公式通过一连串转译，在词语之间建立起同一关系；它完成一次换算：从与另一地点（
j
）相关联的价格系统出发，提供与原有的
Pi
相对应的
Pj
于是一系列等价关系得以建立，使原本不可通约的东西变得可以通约，并为交换物品的货币度量这一无解难题提供了若干解法。这条链条没有尽头。这些度量又依次被转译进不同的、以十二为基数的族群计数系统。例如，
mithqual
相当于穆斯林所定义的1200，而在班巴拉（Bambara）计数系统中则相当于12乘80。
说得直白些，这就好比：我们日常使用、从不觉得有歧义的“百”，并非处处具有相同的值——尽管它处处都被理解——依地点与对话者的不同，它在我们的计数系统中对应“一百”或“八十”。这一新的转译延伸了换算工作，也使价格构式变得更加复杂。

Conversions from one scale to another are nothing other than sophisticated translations that play, so to speak, on ambiguities and semantic polyvalence, notably associated with numbers, as well as with words: language and its games prepare the exchange and serve the formulation. It is not the case that there are, on one side, the evaluations, and on the other, the prices, or on one side, qualitative practices that determine values, and on the other, quantitative ones measuring these values. The same thing, the same word, simultaneously points in both directions. Words and things weave a network of significations that allow transitions, always fragile and open to challenge, from qualitative to quantitative. Guyer explains that one can, for instance, agree that thirty ignames are the same thing as fifty ignames and that for 1,100 CFA, one can get the same thing as for 750, as little as is the case in sales in which all the items between eleven and nineteen euros are sold at a single price of ten euros. In other cases, equivalences are postulated with goods to which a price has already been assigned. To move from a numerical scale (sums of money) to an ordinal scale (that structures intervals between thresholds) and vice versa, there are unlimited translations and therefore formulations. The calculation, both determinate and modular, that regulates the combination of scales in a supple and flexible manner leaves significant room for improvisation.

从一种标度到另一种标度的换算，不过是精巧的转译；可以说，它们利用的是歧义与语义的多价性，尤其是与数字以及词语相关的歧义与多价性：语言及其游戏为交换作了准备，并为构式服务。事情并非一边是评价、另一边是价格，也非一边是决定价值的定性实践、另一边是衡量这些价值的定量实践。同一个事物、同一个词，同时指向两个方向。词语与事物编织出一张意义之网，使从定性到定量的过渡得以可能——这种过渡始终脆弱，随时可能受到质疑。盖耶解释说，例如，人们可以约定三十个山药（ignames）与五十个山药是同一回事，用1100非洲法郎（CFA）可以换得与750非洲法郎相同的东西；这与下述促销同样不足为奇：所有标价在11至19欧元之间的商品，统统以10欧元的单一价格出售。在另一些情况下，人们则设定与已经定价的物品之间的等价关系。要从数值标度（货币数额）过渡到序数标度（它结构化各阈值之间的间隔），再反过来过渡，存在着无穷无尽的转译，因而也存在着无穷无尽的构式。这种既确定又模块化的计算，以柔韧而灵活的方式调节各标度的组合，为即兴发挥留出了相当大的空间。

Guyer introduces the idea of “trope” in order to describe how correlations are regularly established between scales that in principle are unrelated to one another, giving rise to improvisation and innovation. A trope is a figure through which a word or an expression is diverted from its literal meaning, as are the words “ackie,” “cauri,” or “hundred.” It prepares the way for conversion operations. Each scale, whether it be ordinal, nominal, or numerical, has its own tropes through which it can be correlated with the two other scales: worlds that are a priori incommensurable can thereby communicate; beings can be matched with numbers or ranks. The tropes that transform
Pi
into
Pj

are elementary operators of the formulation. They provide pathways for conversions without determining them mechanically. The implementation of these conversion translations requires great ingenuity and high-level skills such as great proficiency in languages, words, kinship relations, or, and clearly this is not an exhaustive list, numbering and measuring systems. These skills are not uniformly distributed. Those who have them or have access to them have an undeniable advantage.

盖耶引入“转义”（trope）这一概念，用以描述原则上互不相关的标度之间如何经常建立起相关性，从而催生即兴发挥与创新。转义是一种修辞格，词语或表达借此偏离其字面意义，“ackie”“cauri”或“百”这些词便是如此。它为换算操作铺平道路。每一种标度——无论是序数的、名义的还是数值的——都有各自的转义，并借此与其他两种标度建立关联：那些先验上不可通约的世界因此得以沟通；存在者也可以与数字或等级相配。把
Pi
转化为
Pj
的转义，是构式的基本算子。它们为换算提供路径，却不机械地决定换算。实施这些换算性转译，需要极大的巧思与高超的技能，例如精通语言、词语、亲属关系，或者——显然这份清单并不穷尽——计数与度量系统。这些技能并非均匀分布。拥有它们或能够接触到它们的人，享有不可否认的优势。
Guyer is no doubt touching on the most fundamental and universal forms of price formulation, those that are embedded in languages themselves, in their tropes and scales.
盖耶无疑触及了价格构式最根本、最普遍的形式，即那些嵌入语言本身、嵌入语言的转义与标度之中的形式。
THE POWER OF FORMULAS
公式的力量

Everyone qualculates, but when it comes to establishing prices, the capacity for designing, discussing, and imposing formulas is unequally distributed. This is as true for the Yorubas as it is in the City of London. We can talk about the power of a formula and therefore of the power of formulating work in the same way that we speak of the calculating power of a computer or a group of statisticians. This power depends upon the capacity to connect a large number of variables, forces, sites, and temporal horizons and to compose with them a figure that is rendered indisputable.
人人都在质算，但一旦涉及确立价格，设计、讨论并强加公式的能力却分布不均。约鲁巴人如此，伦敦金融城（City of London）也是如此。我们可以像谈论一台计算机或一群统计学家的计算能力那样，谈论一个公式的力量，因而也谈论构式工作的力量。这种力量取决于这样一种能力：把大量变量、力量、场所与时间视野连接起来，并用它们拼合出一个被确立为无可争议的数值。

In his remarkable study of the world cotton market, anthropologist Koray Çalişkan observes the existence of both multiple local prices, such as those established on the İzmir Exchange or over the course of a bilateral negotiation between a small Egyptian cotton producer and a trading company, and prices that are described as global, such as those affixed by the New York Board of Trade. (Global prices are themselves multiple because they apply to different types of financial derivatives.) All of these prices lead to the proliferation and singularization of different categories of cotton — most notably, different because they are deliverable in different places at different times.

These prices, whether they be local or global, are connected through the multiple formulas put to use by agents at multiple sites distant from one another at the moment of bilateral transactions. A formula adopted at site

to determine a price can establish a connection with a site
Si
by integrating

Pj

Sj
. Several formulations can thus enter into competition at site
Sj
, depending upon the choice of other sites,
Si
, that they take into account, as well as the choice of coefficients that connect the various corresponding values of
Pi

人类学家科拉伊·恰勒什坎（Koray Çalişkan）在其对世界棉花市场的出色研究中观察到，既存在多重地方价格——例如在伊兹密尔交易所（İzmir Exchange）确立的价格，或一位埃及小棉农与一家贸易公司双边谈判过程中确立的价格——也存在被称作全球价格的价格，例如纽约贸易委员会（New York Board of Trade）所确定的价格。（全球价格本身也是多重的，因为它们适用于不同类型的金融衍生品。）所有这些价格都导致不同类别棉花的增殖与独一化——这些类别之所以不同，最显著的原因在于它们可在不同地点、不同时间交割。
这些价格，无论地方性的还是全球性的，都通过行动者在双边交易时刻、在彼此相距遥远的多个场所所使用的多重公式而相互连接。在场所
